ranks: The need-keys recheck list R9 (Phase 1 step 2)

authored.name: Cecil, Dark Knight // Cecil, Redeemed Paladin

blocked.name: Lulu, Stern Guardian
blocked.why: The attacks-player trigger is player-only now, but the `creature-attacking-you` target still admits creatures attacking your planeswalkers; Lulu's ruling says only you.

blocked.name: Meriadoc Brandybuck
blocked.why: 'One or more Halflings you control attack a player': attacks-player fires once per player attacked but has no attacker filter.

blocked.name: The Earth King
blocked.why: attack-with gives no count of the matching attackers for 'up to that many' basic lands.

blocked.name: Generous Patron
blocked.why: counters-put fires once per counter kind, so proliferating a creature with two kinds would draw two cards.

blocked.name: Wildwood Scourge
blocked.why: 'Another non-Hydra creature': counters-put has no otherOnly, and the Hydra filter alone counts Scourge once it stops being a Hydra.

blocked.name: Arcbond
blocked.why: An until-end-of-turn 'whenever that creature is dealt damage' about the target creature, with it as the damage source: the delayed whenever watch can only name the creating object.

blocked.name: Blazing Sunsteel
blocked.why: '+1/+0 for each opponent you have': grantPtPerCount counts no players. The damage trigger itself is dealt-damage `who: "attached"` with `from: "trigger-object"`.

blocked.name: Dragonborn Champion
blocked.why: 'Deals 5 or more damage to a player': deals-damage has `exactly` but no N-or-more, and a trigger-value condition is only asked as an effect resolves.

blocked.name: Spinneret and Spiderling
blocked.why: 'Deals 4 or more damage', summed once per event (now built), but no N-or-more gate on the trigger.

blocked.name: Obelisk Spider
blocked.why: 'Put a -1/-1 counter on that creature' (the creature dealt combat damage): add-counter takes no trigger-recipient target.

blocked.name: Vengeful Pharaoh
blocked.why: 'Whenever combat damage is dealt to you or a planeswalker you control', once per event from the graveyard: deals-damage-batch reaches players only.

blocked.name: Arashin War Beast
blocked.why: 'Deals combat damage to one or more blocking creatures' once per step: a deals-damage trigger naming a recipient fires once per recipient.

blocked.name: Briarbridge Patrol
blocked.why: 'Deals damage to one or more creatures' once per event (the ruling): with a recipient named, deals-damage fires once per creature.

blocked.name: Justice
blocked.why: 'Whenever a red creature or spell deals damage': no source filter reads 'a creature or a spell', and red alone also matches a red noncreature permanent.

blocked.name: The Council of Four
blocked.why: A player's second draw / second spell *during their turn*: nthEachTurn counts any turn and there's no 'the actor is the active player' clause.

blocked.name: Gaea's Blessing
blocked.why: 'When this card is put into your graveyard from your library' — no self trigger of the milled card.

blocked.name: Bomb Squad
blocked.why: 'Whenever a creature has four or more fuse counters on it … destroy it': on: "state" takes only a condition, with no matching creature as the trigger object.

blocked.name: Olivia, Crimson Bride
blocked.why: The returned creature gains 'When you don't control a legendary Vampire, exile this creature': put-onto-battlefield grants nothing, and a granted state trigger is unproven.

blocked.name: Coveted Jewel
blocked.why: 'One or more creatures an opponent controls attack you and aren't blocked' once per batch: attacks-unblocked fires per attacker.

blocked.name: Arvinox, the Mind Flail
blocked.why: The bottom card of each opponent's library exiled face down, lookable, castable as permanent spells with any-color mana for as long as it stays exiled: impulse-exile takes the top.

blocked.name: Dire Fleet Daredevil
blocked.why: exile's mayCast (end-of-turn, any-type) is there, but not 'if that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead'.

blocked.name: Thada Adel, Acquisitor
blocked.why: search-library can't search that player's library into exile with a play-this-turn permission.

blocked.name: Assemble the Players
blocked.why: castFromLibraryTop has the filter but no once-each-turn limit.

blocked.name: Fblthp, Lost on the Range
blocked.why: Granting plot to the top card of the library and plotting from there.

blocked.name: Gwenom, Remorseless
blocked.why: A one-shot until-end-of-turn play-from-top permission, with spells cast that way costing life equal to their mana value.

blocked.name: Into the Pit
blocked.why: castFromLibraryTop has no additional 'sacrifice a nonland permanent' cost.

blocked.name: Inverter of Truth
blocked.why: exile-from-library has no face-down option (the ruling: no one may look).

blocked.name: Thief of Sanity
blocked.why: Top three of that player's library: one exiled face down castable while exiled (any type), the rest into their graveyard — impulse-exile's choose leaves the rest exiled.

blocked.name: Vivien, Champion of the Wilds
blocked.why: −2's exiled card is castable for as long as it remains exiled if it's a creature spell: look-and-choose's exile has no standing permission (cast-now is during resolution only).

blocked.name: Aerial Extortionist
blocked.why: 'Its owner may cast it for as long as it remains exiled' from now: laterTurns starts next turn and mayCast is the controller's.

blocked.name: Cruelclaw's Heist
blocked.why: Exiling a card you choose from a revealed hand, with a gift-conditional cast-while-exiled any-type permission.

blocked.name: Hurl Through Hell
blocked.why: exile's mayCast lasts this turn or while exiled, not until the end of your next turn.

blocked.name: Kheru Spellsnatcher
blocked.why: Counter-and-exile is there; casting the card free for as long as it remains exiled is not.

blocked.name: Spelljack
blocked.why: Playing the countered card free for as long as it remains exiled.

blocked.name: Thranduil's Decree
blocked.why: Casting the countered permanent card free for as long as it remains exiled.

blocked.name: Nivix, Aerie of the Firemind
blocked.why: The permission ends as your next turn begins; `your-next-turn` lasts until it ends.

blocked.name: Norin, Swift Survivalist
blocked.why: Exiling the blocked creature with a *play* permission this turn: exile's mayCast is cast-only.

blocked.name: Share the Spoils
blocked.why: A pool of exiled cards each player may play from on their own turn, re-exiling on use, and a 'whenever an opponent loses the game' trigger.

blocked.name: Tablet of Discovery
blocked.why: 'You may play that card this turn' on the milled card, lands included.

blocked.name: Intrepid Paleontologist
blocked.why: Casting Dinosaurs from among cards you own exiled with it, each entering with a finality counter.

blocked.name: Decaying Soil
blocked.why: A threshold-granted dies trigger is checked after the event: tested, the creature that makes the seventh card still triggers it, and the ruling (rule 603.10a) says it mustn't.

blocked.name: Planetarium of Wan Shi Tong
blocked.why: 'Do this only once each turn' is spent only by casting the card (the ruling): a trigger oncePerTurn stops it after a scry where nothing was cast, and a may with oncePerTurn asks before the card is seen.
